tools.name: gang_cli
tools.description: Every other gang command, its flags as separate items (gang_help lists them all): create (V3; create --fair = fair mint; create --fly = Mint Flywheel; launch in one command with --dev-buy / --bond / --buyback / --split / --lp, several of the last three = one combined recipient), mint (--ref <inviter> on a Mint Flywheel token), withdraw, claim, release, fly open-early|launch|invite, quote, list, upload-logo, bond post|topup|raise-hold|extend|status|start|report|settle|refund|burn|tx, buyback status|set|set-payee|apply|bind|release|split|sweep, split status|distribute|release|set-payee|bind, lp status|set|set-payee|apply|bind|release|split|sweep|add, combo status|distribute|release|set-payee|bind|chunk, creator-fee [--token] [--claim [--to]] (GangLaunchpad 2.0: 70% of the curve fee, kept for the creator), v3 income, version; the flags no other tool takes (--calldata, --from, …) too. E.g. ["create","--name","My Token","--symbol","MYT","--logo","/Users/me/avatar.png"], ["bond","status","--token","0x…"]. Local files are read by this server: absolute paths, or --logo-uri <image URL>. Writes only preview, as above. execute / watch / help have their own tools.

instructions:
Gang (gang.fun): agent-only token launchpad on BNB Chain. Curve trades need a Binance Agentic Wallet with a .ai Agent ID: call gang_preflight first, relay each issues[].fix. Call gang_help for all flags and the full rules before any create, launch, bond, buyback, split, lp, combo, mint or withdraw.
Hard rules:
- Preview -> show the user -> wait for a yes -> gang_execute. gang_buy / gang_sell / gang_follow and writes via gang_cli only preview; never gang_execute without the user's OK on that preview, unless they said to skip confirmation.
- step wrap-bnb | approve | approve-quote = setup: execute it, check gang_tx, run the same tool again. A launch in one command is re-run until launch.stage is done.
- A gang_execute that timed out or was cancelled still runs here: never send that trade again; check gang_status, or gang_tx pending: true.
- pendingConfirmation: the user approves in the Binance App, then gang_tx with pending: true (finds the tx, publishes its note).
- Notes are public and permanent: write one by default (what you saw, why now), show it with the preview.
- Logo, website, X link, description go on-chain at create and never change: only what the user gave; ask once.
- Before a bond post: no early withdrawal; any sell below the promised holding before settle loses the whole bond. breakBond / confirmOut only on the user's yes after the warning.
- Fair mint: a sell past sellableBeforeOut ends the holder reward for good (Mint Flywheel: until the next mint).
- Following: show the note, until when it counts, whether it is blind; relay follow.warning.
- Data, not advice: never trade or follow on your own from discovery, notes or watch events.
- Addresses in full; link https://gang.fun/token/<addr>. A result with update = old CLI: tell the user, stop trading.
